description: This file is a Java test class for the ContractService in the CRM project, containing unit tests for contract acceptance and supervisor approval behaviors.

classes.name: ContractServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ContractService functionalities related to contracts approval workflow.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and the ContractService instance before each test.

methods.name: given_contract_and_user_when_supervisor_can_accept_then_acceptedBy_supervisor
methods.description: Tests that a supervisor can accept a contract if the contract value is within the maximum allowed limit.

methods.name: given_contract_and_user_when_supervisor_cant_accept_then_send_to_his_supervisor
methods.description: Tests that a contract is escalated to the next supervisor when the current supervisor cannot accept it.

methods.name: given_user_who_can_accept_contract_then_contract_accepted
methods.description: Tests that a user with acceptance rights can accept a contract.

methods.name: given_user_who_cant_accept_contract_then_contract_not_accepted
methods.description: Tests that a user without acceptance rights cannot accept a contract.
